text: Our only line is raising young maples and shrubs on our own land, then selling our stock to household gardeners. The plants leave us well before ten years.
We sell young trees and shrubs to people for their gardens. Every plant arrives ready to sell from outside growers; we do no growing.
Customers buy garden shrubs we have propagated and raised here. This is the whole business, and we sell the young stock rather than holding trees for a decade.
All our sales are young trees and shrubs to household gardeners. The return does not say whether we raise the stock ourselves or buy ready-grown stock for resale.
We fit sheets of glass into openings that builders have already prepared in houses and shops. We do not supply whole window assemblies and we never work on vehicles.
We replace cracked windscreens and mend chipped car windows. Motor-vehicle glass is all we work on.
Our workshop deals exclusively with broken or chipped vehicle windows, taking out damaged panes and fitting replacements.
The firm only replaces glass panes. Its incomplete return does not establish whether these go in prepared building openings or in motor vehicles.
We mix flour into dough and bake loaves in this shop. People buy the bread to take home; there is no service for eating it here and we do not buy ready-made dough.
We sell finished loaves delivered by other bakeries. Nothing is baked here, and customers take their purchases home rather than eat them in the shop.
All of our bread starts as flour in our own kitchen, becomes dough, and is baked here for customers to carry home. We do not sell prepared meals.
This shop sells loaves for people to take home. The return omits whether it makes and bakes them from flour here or buys already-baked loaves from elsewhere.
We develop and distribute an installable bookkeeping program sold in the same packaged form to many buyers. It is not a game, a hosted online service, or custom work for one client.
Each customer commissions us to write and test a different business application around its requirements. We do not publish packaged products, make games, or run hosted software services.
Our programmers build non-game applications to an individual clients specification and test the commissioned result. There is no standard software product for sale.

The business supplies installable non-game software rather than hosted access. The return does not state whether it publishes one packaged product or writes applications to individual client specifications.
Clients hire us to audit their accounting records, prepare management accounting reports and advise on their accounting systems. This is our principal service.
We handle customers transaction books, invoices and wage runs. We offer neither audits nor accounting reports; billing and payroll processing are the entire service.
Our main work is reviewing the accuracy of client accounts, conducting audits and preparing accounting reports for management.
This firm handles client financial records. The return leaves unresolved whether it supplies accounting and audit reports or restricts itself to transaction books, billing and payroll.
We plan how park land should be laid out and prepare the landscape drawings and design administration. We do not plant, build, mow or maintain the sites.
Our crews put in lawns, shrubs and garden beds, then maintain them. Physical garden installation and upkeep are our service; we do not run a separate architectural practice.
We send crews to establish lawns and planted beds and return to care for them. Our business is the hands-on installation and upkeep of landscapes.
The firm works on parks. The record does not distinguish a practice providing only landscape plans and design administration from a contractor installing and maintaining the planted areas.
We wash the windows of buildings and offer no other cleaning service.
We clean office rooms and their toilets after working hours. We do not wash windows or offer specialist carpet cleaning.
Our crews clean only panes of building windows; they do not clean rooms or wash carpets.
The cleaning contract is either window-only work or general office-interior cleaning without windows; the incomplete return does not specify which.
Licensed vets at our clinic diagnose illnesses in cats and dogs, prescribe treatment and perform animal operations. This medical practice is our main activity.
We look after dogs and cats while their owners are away and wash and trim their coats. We neither breed pets nor provide medical treatment.
Owners leave cats and dogs with us for overnight care and coat grooming. We have no veterinary practice and do not breed animals.
This establishment serves pet cats and dogs. The record explicitly leaves unresolved whether its activity is licensed veterinary treatment or only grooming and boarding.
Members of the public put coins into our washing machines and operate the machines themselves. Providing those self-service facilities is our whole activity.
Customers leave their own clothes and sheets with our staff to wash and press. We supply no rented linen, and customers do not run the machines themselves.
People bring their washing, feed coins into the machines and do the washing themselves. We only provide the self-service facilities.
The establishment washes customers own clothing, but the return omits whether customers operate coin machines themselves or employees wash and press the items for them.
We manufacture glass by melting sand together with cullet. We are making the glass itself rather than shaping glass bought from another producer.
We buy glass and turn it into shaped articles by reheating, pressing and blowing it. We do not produce glass from sand and cullet.
Our input is purchased glass; we soften it and press or blow it into finished shapes. We do not make raw glass from mineral ingredients.
The factory makes glass articles. The return does not establish whether it makes glass from sand and cullet or only shapes purchased glass.
We print high-resolution graphic posters on computer-controlled inkjet equipment. The image reaches the machine as a computer file; this is not office photocopying.
We make commercial paper posters by pushing ink through silk screens and cutting stencils. We do not print textile fabric.
Our poster-printing jobs arrive as digital files and run through non-impact inkjet equipment. We are not a walk-in photocopy shop.
The establishment commercially prints paper posters. The response leaves unresolved whether it uses non-impact computer-file printing or silk screens and stencils.
We mainly sell new cars and light trucks to final buyers. We also take some used vehicles in trade and sell those.
We sell second-hand cars and light trucks. We never sell brand-new motor vehicles.
All vehicles on our lot have had a previous owner. Retailing these used cars and light trucks is the business; we do not sell new ones.
This dealership retails cars and light trucks. The return does not distinguish a mainly new-vehicle dealership with some used sales from a used-only dealer.
I examine financial records independently against accounting standards and report the results of my audits. I am not a department manager.
I keep the complete transaction books, post journal entries, balance the ledger and prepare trial balances. I do not carry out independent financial audits.
My work is to test whether an establishments financial records comply with accounting standards, then issue findings from the audit. I do not manage its finance department.
The worker handles accounting records. The incomplete description leaves unresolved whether the role is conducting financial audits or maintaining complete transaction books.
I develop and evaluate employment and labour-relations policies and advise employers on collective agreements. I do not manage the HR department.
I turn staffing vacancies into advertisements, collect applications and help select candidates. I do not design employment policies.
When posts become vacant, I arrange the adverts, gather applicants and assist with the selection. Employment-policy development is outside my work.
The worker is in human resources but not a department manager. The record cannot distinguish policy and collective-agreement advice from advertising vacancies and recruiting candidates.
I am licensed to practise veterinary medicine. I diagnose animal illness, prescribe treatment and perform animal surgery.
I work as an animal-health technician under a veterinarian, help with treatment and carry out laboratory tests. I do not independently diagnose, prescribe or perform surgery.
As the licensed animal doctor, I determine the illness, choose and prescribe treatment and operate when needed.
The clinical worker is either the licensed veterinarian or an animal-health technician assisting one. Their exact role and diagnostic authority were not recorded.
I am a licensed pharmacist. I review patients medication therapy, advise them on safe use and dispense their prescriptions.
I am a regulated pharmacy technician doing the technical preparation and dispensing tasks under a pharmacist. I do not provide the pharmacists clinical medication advice.
My regulated technical role in the dispensary is preparing and dispensing medicines under the pharmacist, rather than giving clinical medication advice.
The return identifies a dispensary worker as either a licensed pharmacist or a regulated pharmacy technician, but the role and clinical responsibilities are missing.
I teach academic subjects to classes in a secondary school. I am the classroom teacher, not the head or an assistant.
I teach basic subjects to elementary-school pupils as their classroom teacher. I am neither a principal nor a teaching assistant.
My pupils attend secondary school, where I lead subject lessons as the teacher. I do not work as the principal or support assistant.
This employee is the classroom teacher rather than a principal or assistant. The school level was omitted, leaving elementary versus secondary teaching unresolved.
I provide dental-hygiene care: assess oral health and scale teeth to prevent gum disease. I am not a dentist or laboratory worker.
During dental treatment I prepare patients, pass instruments to the dentist and sterilize equipment afterwards. I do not assess oral health independently or scale teeth.
My job is chairside help for the dentist, including readying the patient and instruments and sterilizing tools, not independent hygiene assessment or scaling.
The worker is in a dental clinic. The description leaves unresolved whether they independently provide hygiene assessment and scaling or only assist the dentist at the chair.
I install and repair the wiring, lights and circuits of homes and offices. I do not supervise others or work on the electricity grid.
I service the electrical motors and automated controls of factory production machinery. I am not a supervisor or a power-grid worker.
Homes and office buildings are where I fit and repair circuits and lighting wiring. I do not supervise crews or maintain grid equipment.
The worker is an electrician, not a supervisor or grid worker. The return does not specify building wiring work versus industrial machinery and electrical controls.
I diagnose and repair engines, brakes and transmissions on motor vehicles. I do mechanical servicing and do not supervise a team.
I straighten and replace crash-damaged car panels and repaint vehicle bodies. I do not service engines or supervise other workers.
After a collision I restore the damaged body panels and refinish the paint. Mechanical engine repairs and supervision are outside my role.
The person repairs motor vehicles without supervising. The report omits whether this means mechanical engines and brakes or collision-damaged body panels.
I design how websites look and how their pages are laid out and used. I do not write or test the program code.
I write, change, integrate and test the code behind websites and web applications. My main work is programming functionality, not drawing visual layouts.
I decide the appearance, page arrangement and usability design of websites, while other people implement and test the code.
The worker makes websites. The return does not resolve whether their main role is visual and usability design or writing and testing website program code.
I follow established recipes to cook full meals and savoury dishes in a restaurant. I am not the executive chef.
I prepare bread and pastry dough and bake it in a bakery using established recipes. I am not a pastry chef or a factory processing-machine operator.
My bakery work is mixing bread and pastry dough and baking the batches to established recipes, not being a pastry chef or operating a factory processing line.
This worker follows established recipes and is not a chef or factory-machine operator. The response omits whether they cook meals or make and bake bread and pastry dough.
I clean hotel bedrooms, make beds, change sheets, dust furniture and restock toiletries. I do not supervise other staff.
I remove heavy building debris with industrial vacuum equipment and clear snow from the building walkways. I am not a supervisor or a specialist who maintains building systems.
My hotel rounds are guest-room housekeeping: clean the room, change its linen, make the bed and replenish toiletries. I have no supervisory role.
The worker cleans a building without supervising or maintaining its technical systems. Guest-room housekeeping versus heavy-debris cleaning and snow clearance is not specified.
I am a registered nurse providing bedside care, monitoring patients and giving medicines prescribed by a physician. I have no nurse-practitioner role and do not supervise the ward.
I am an advanced-practice nurse with authority to examine patients, order tests, diagnose illnesses and prescribe treatment. I am not a physician.
In my advanced nursing role I use nurse-practitioner authority to diagnose, request diagnostic tests and prescribe treatment after examining patients. I am not a doctor.

The employee is a registered nurse providing clinical care rather than a physician or ward supervisor. The record does not establish whether they have and use nurse-practitioner diagnostic and prescribing authority.
